Maria (docs): quick sync — I'm making a tiny "mini-migration" playbook for customers moving from Legacy SDK -> Optimize toolkit. want to keep it lightweight (one page) with 3 example snippets: batching, kv-prefetch, quant profile. thoughts?
Ajay (eng): love the idea. can we include a minimal `requests` + SDK v2 -> v3 diff? customers get stuck on header/auth and streaming.
Selena (opt): +1. also add a short section: when to pick `dynamic_batch=auto` vs `manual`. 1-2 sentence rationale.
Taylor (pm): keep it product-facing: call out benefits (latency down, cost down) and caveats (short-seq perf). i'll draft bullets.
Maria (docs): ok i'll draft. Ajay can you paste the minimal code snippet for kv-prefetch? maybe a 3-line example.
Ajay (eng): here, use this for the SDK snippet (feel free to inline):
```python
from redwood import Client
cli = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
resp = cli.generate("summarize: keep it short", prefetch_kv=True)
```
Maria (docs): perfect — i'll add an italic note: "prefetch helps when there's prefix reuse (>60% identical starts)". Selena — can you write a 1-liner quant recommendation?
Selena (opt): put this: "Use int8 quant for high-throughput read-heavy workloads; prefer fp16 for latency-sensitive short sequences. Run a 50-sample eval on representative prompts to validate quality delta."
Taylor (pm): for links: we should reference the telemetry guide and the rollout playbook. Maria, do we want a 'quick-checklist' at the top? e.g., 1) run smoke eval, 2) enable prefetch, 3) tune batch size.
docbot: PR #8423 opened by Maria — "mini-migration-roadmap-snippets" — 1 file added. CI: docs-lint passed, linkcheck failed: 1 broken link.
Maria (docs): ack on linkcheck. i think the broken link is to an old `kv-prefetch` path. Ajay can you confirm canonical URL?
Ajay (eng): canonical is https://docs.redwood.ai/optimize/kv-prefetch — update in PR to that.
Maria (docs): updated. also adding a tiny example showing `batching_policy` json for server config:```json
{
  "batching_policy": {
    "max_batch_tokens": 4096,
    "min_requests": 2,
    "timeout_ms": 30
  }
}
```
Selena (opt): nice. add a short note: "if latency spikes, reduce timeout_ms to 10 and lower max_batch_tokens."
Taylor (pm): can we include a short 'rollback' line: how to revert to legacy routing? just one command or UI step.
Maria (docs): yes — i'll add: "toggle deployment -> routes -> select previous model variant -> promote." will include screenshots in next PR iteration.
Ajay (eng): small nit: please call out SDK auth header example for streaming, some customers miss `Accept: text/event-stream`.
Maria (docs): added. final checklist for merge: @Selena confirm quant line, @Ajay confirm URLs and auth snippet, @Taylor bless copy. aiming to merge EOD. :shipit: 
Selena (opt): confirmed — thumbs up.
Ajay (eng): urls + auth snippet confirmed.
Taylor (pm): looks good to me. merging after docbot clears linkcheck.
docbot: linkcheck re-run passing. PR #8423 merged. :tada:
